hook_text: An egg, a peanut and a glass of milk. Each one is hiding a secret. Can you find it?
clip_script: Food Detective Day in Mthatha. Clue one: an egg has protein, fat, vitamins and minerals. Clue two: milk has protein, fat, sugar and calcium. Clue three: rub a peanut on brown paper and hold it to the light. A see-through spot. Fat! Drop iodine on beans: blue-black. Starch! Most natural foods hide more than one nutrient.
visual_style: Whiteboard magnifying glass sliding over an egg, milk and peanuts, with nutrient labels popping out of each.
mood: Playful mystery, like a detective game.
pacing: Three clues, two tests, one big conclusion.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and read the food label on a packet at home.
